1-3 years One year Cath Lab Cardiovascular Techexperience in the Cardiac Catheterization Lab or Interventional Radiology experience which includes assisting (hemodynamic monitoring, scrubbing and circulating) in relevant diagnostic and interventional cardiac cath/peripheral procedures within the last year., upon hire
Prepares sterile procedure table, using sterile technique, with equipment, materials, and fluids necessary during procedure
Assists the cardiologist as a scrub technician for all diagnostic and interventional cardiac catheterization procedures

Monitors responsibilities, including but not limited to, patient electrocardiogram and hemodynamic monitoring, data collection, correlation and documentation. Informs medical and clinical staff of any changes in patient status

Performs and maintains competency with all aspects of arterial and venous hemostasis, including manual compression. Informs medical and clinical staff immediately of any suspected bleeding, ecchymosis and/or hematoma formation
Assists clinical staff with post-procedural patient care, monitoring, and transportation
Monitors supplies used during a procedure to ensure appropriate patient billing for supplies and services
Graduate from an accredited school for Cardiovascular Technology or Radiologic Technology required, upon hire and
Advanced Cardiac Life Support, upon hire (Must be through the American Heart Association)
